configurations.//web: Pinned to 3000, not autoPort: Clerk's dev instance authorises http://localhost:3000 (CLERK_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES) and the API's CORS allowlist matches it, so on any other port sign-in fails. Free the port rather than moving the app.
configurations.name: web

configurations.//web-prod: `next start` against the .next-build output, which is the mode the product is actually deployed in — and the one that avoids next dev's stale-chunk failures after files are added or removed. Requires `npm run build:web` first; it serves a build, it does not make one.
configurations.name: web-prod
